title: Add compact universal certificates for dirty linear circuits (no new κ)
body:
Dirty-register identities are repeatedly checked on small matrices or by expanding free words before recursive substitution. This adds a reusable bridge to classical weighted-automata equivalence: compile a program with **r input roles and q unary calls into r+q states**, then certify its complete endpoint with exact subspace-closure equations. Expanded word count does not enter the state bound.

The package includes a written proof, certificate producer, separately transcribed checker requiring no search/elimination, explicit nilpotent or invertible unipotent counterexamples, and a short contributor guide linked from the standing procedure. It supports Q, Q(i), and prime fields. All borrowed inputs and returned fields remain independent. The pinned existing dirty-echo scheduler is translated literally; its construction and arbitrary-n/rounded proof retain predecessor credit.

Validation on Python 3.12.8: both registered normal/optimized replays pass; 210 complete source-echo identities, 120 explicit-word differential circuits, 180 literal matrix counterexamples, 15 certificate rejections, field/tensor controls, and three committed examples. A **2^64-word** stress endpoint uses **130 states and 65 invariant rows**. Git-free normal/optimized export replays pass, with every exported regular file unchanged. Committed-byte and export-integrity checks pass. The optional full-history preflight refuses this shallow checkout; the declared base is the freshly fetched canonical main and an ancestor of this contribution. No full-history pass is claimed.

Scope: this proves the independent-operator algebraic substitution obligation. Inverse, commutation, Clifford, typed rectangular, nonlinear, native, precision, stock, hosting, tape and full paid/outer obligations remain separate. A negative result need not survive extra operator relations. No supplier admission, new kappa, selected-frontier change, human review or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

Classical PIT/equivalence credit: Kiefer (2020 notes), Raz–Shpilka (2005). Project predecessors: the androolloyd dirty-echo package following chafreaky #628 / Ali Romman #621; Cinna Davis #4100/#4088 and ToikY’s free-word tensor audit; the universal dirty-phase audit following Charles Bethin #1278. Their exact source/context pins and wider credit appear in the package.

Start at `docs/research/universal-dirty-circuit-guide.md` and `research/universal-dirty-certificates/README.md`; proof, exact commands, source pins, environment, transcript and Open next questions are included. Base: `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, priority 7. Prepared for @zxv with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

[Hosted run 39958986337](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39958986337) passed both planning and the focused Linux replay on exact head `48976daa4dce59b4867ef046da72a370e389925d`; its committed-input check also passed. Hosted execution is not independent scientific acceptance.
